editor.label: Admin password
editor.description: Players log in as admin with #login <password> in the chat. No spaces.

editor.label: Scenario id
editor.description: The .conf id of the scenario, e.g. {ECC61978EDCC2B5A}Missions/23_Campaign.conf (Conflict - Everon) or {59AD59368755F41A}Missions/21_GM_Eden.conf (Game Master - Everon). All official ids are in scenarios.txt in the service folder. For a Workshop scenario, add its mod below and use the id from its Workshop page.

editor.label: Admins (JSON list)
editor.description: Identity ids or Steam ids that are admins without a password (20 at most), e.g. ["76561198000000000"]. Keep [] for none.

editor.label: Network view distance (m)
editor.description: How far replicated entities stream to players.

editor.label: Minimum grass distance (m)
editor.description: The grass distance players are forced to see at least.

editor.label: Fast validation (keep on for public servers)
Radios can transmit to other factions
Mods (JSON list)
editor.description: Workshop mods the server downloads and players get on join. Each entry: {"modId": "<id from the Workshop page>", "name": "<any label>"}, add "version": "x.y.z" to pin one. Keep [] for none.

editor.label: Maximum server FPS
editor.description: Caps the server tick rate to save CPU. 60 is the usual value for public servers.

editor.label: Server name
editor.description: Shown in the server browser (100 characters at most).

editor.label: Join password
editor.description: Leave empty for a public server.
